value.name: lawyer blocks house sale
value.description: The lawyer explains that the sale cannot proceed because the codicil requires agreement from all three heirs.
evidence: I notify the probate court of the existence of the amendment.
The sale you have in motion does not go forward without the agreement of all three heirs, which means it does not go forward at this time.

value.name: heirs must decide house shares
value.description: The lawyer tells the three heirs they must decide what to do with their shares and discuss the house together.
evidence: Your sister and Rosa will need to decide what they want to do with their shares, and you will need to decide what you want to do with yours, and the three of you will need to have a conversation that I suspect is going to take longer than a week.

value.name: lawyer imposes thirty-day pause
value.description: The lawyer asks the heirs not to make any decisions about the house for at least thirty days.
evidence: I am going to ask all three of you not to make any decisions about the disposition of the house for at least thirty days.

value.name: lawyer instructs buyer cancellation
value.description: The lawyer tells Mr. Serrano to call the buyers that afternoon and say the property is no longer available on the planned timeline.
evidence: I am going to ask you, Mr. Serrano, to call your buyers this afternoon and inform them that the property is no longer available on the timeline you discussed.

value.name: lawyer keeps Ms Serrano in residence
value.description: The lawyer instructs Ms. Serrano to remain living in the house until further notice.
evidence: I am going to ask you, Ms. Serrano, to remain in residence until further notice.

value.name: lawyer redefines Rosa's status
value.description: The lawyer tells Rosa to accept that she is now a one-third owner of the house rather than an employee.
evidence: And I am going to ask you, Ms. Maldonado, to do me the personal favor of accepting that you are now a one-third owner of this house and not, regardless of what your habits tell you, an employee in it any longer.

value.name: Rosa reacts quietly
value.description: Rosa makes a small, almost-laughing sound in response to the lawyer's declaration.
evidence: Rosa made a small sound. Not quite a laugh.

value.name: Rosa agrees to try
value.description: Rosa responds that she will try to accept her new status.

value.name: Daniel asks lawyer to stay for lunch
value.description: Daniel unexpectedly asks the lawyer to stay for lunch.
evidence: "Will you — would you stay for lunch."

value.name: Asha is surprised by invitation
value.description: Asha is taken aback by Daniel's invitation and realizes he is speaking sincerely rather than performing.
evidence: It was so unexpected that for a moment Asha did not understand the question.
He was not, she saw, performing.
he was asking the question of a man who had just been disassembled in his mother's dining room and who did not know how to put himself back together
